# CopyController

> Copies a value to the clipboard and shows visual feedback, dispatching `ui-copy`.

## Constructor

```ts
new CopyController(host: HTMLElement, options?: CopyOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `value` | `string | (() => string)` | no |  |
| `feedbackDuration` | `number` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-copy` | `{ value }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { CopyController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new CopyController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
